description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDao class which manages database operations related to EmployeeMembership entities, such as saving, retrieving by ID, deleting, and searching based on filters in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeMembership entities, providing methods to save, retrieve, delete, and search employee memberships in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Persists a new EmployeeMembership entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership entity by employee number and membership ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeMembershipIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing EmployeeMembership IDs for a given employee number and list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes EmployeeMemberships for a specific employee based on a list of IDs, returning the number of deleted entries.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Performs a search for EmployeeMembership entities based on provided filter parameters, returning matching records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Paginator object for EmployeeMembership search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeMembership entries matching the search filter parameters.
